Tumor originates in uterine endometrium, outside the axes; neuroendocrine differentiation and possible ectopic secretion do not establish endocrine-gland disease.
Disease of the cardiac electrical conduction system.
Female genital prolapse is reproductive; urinary tract prolapse occurs in particular subtypes and does not define the entire umbrella.
Congenital cranial nerve dysinnervation causes restricted ocular movement, globe retraction and strabismus.
Syndactyly, renal malformations and anal atresia define STAR; cardiac septal abnormalities occur in 30-79%. Telecanthus alone does not establish ocular damage.

Nonsyndromic intellectual disability, sometimes with seizures; no demonstrated systemic metabolic phenotype.

Meningeal tumor at the foramen magnum; location beside skull bone does not establish a skeletal tumor.

Cobalamin metabolic defect; intellectual disability and movement dysfunction occur in 80-99%, as does megaloblastic marrow disease.

Brain, eye and nasal malformations define disease; cleft palate occurs in 12/20 (60%). Frequent polydactyly is omitted under the four-axis cap.
Fatty-acid and amino-acid oxidation disorder; lipid-storage myopathy with muscle weakness is the predominant manifestation of mild, later-onset disease.
Systemic small-vessel disease with retinal and cerebral injury; nephropathy occurs in 30-79%. Hepatic vascular injury/NRH also occurs in 30-79%, omitted under cap.
Respiratory ciliary dysfunction causes bronchiectasis and chronic airway disease; recurrent middle-ear inflammation occurs in 3/5 (60%).
Benign tumor originates in subcutaneous tissue or deep connective soft tissue.
Primary microcephaly with brain malformations and severe developmental impairment; cerebral visual impairment is central, without demonstrated eye disease.
Glycolytic enzyme deficiency causes chronic hemolytic anemia. Jaundice and hepatomegaly do not establish liver injury; neurological impairment is rare.
Mitochondrial disorder with encephalopathy and intestinal pseudo-obstruction; neurogenic bladder occurs in 4/7 (57%). Macular degeneration in 3/7 (43%) omitted under cap.
Inflammation of neuronal tissue; an infectious, autoimmune or other specifically immune-mediated etiology is not established by this broad concept.
Inherited retinal degeneration caused by REEP6 variants; no additional organ involvement is established.
